feed.title: Re: RFC: Two years of BIP Editing, time for some new faces?

entry.title: Re: RFC: Two years of BIP Editing, time for some new faces?
entry.summary:
Recent discussions have seen renewed interest in collaborative efforts, with particular appreciation expressed towards individuals who have played key roles in re-engaging the group and taking initiative. The contributions from various members highlight a collective commitment to advancing ongoing projects.
Active participation in the Bitcoin Development Mailing List continues to foster dialogue among developers, ensuring that essential topics remain at the forefront of community attention. This engagement strengthens both the technical and organizational aspects of development, encouraging the sharing of insights and support for new ideas.
For those interested in following or joining these conversations, more information is available through the [Bitcoin Development Mailing List](https://groups.google.com/g/bitcoin-dev).
